# Cardenza (鸣片)

> Cardenza is a pocket synthesizer from 203 Systems built around an ESP32-S3, featuring 56 backlit keys, a 240×135 color display, speaker, microphone, SD card slot, and USB. It ships with the 203 Launcher for installing community firmware using 6-character codes. This site (cardenza.203.io) hosts the guide and manual; the firmware community is at https://stage.203.io.

## Developing firmware for Cardenza

- **SDK**: CardenzaHAL (ESP-IDF component) at https://github.com/203-Systems/CardenzaHAL (see its README for hardware specs and headers).
- **CLI & Agent Skill**: `203cli` (from 203-CLI) is required to scaffold projects, flash firmware through the Launcher over USB, read device logs, and publish releases. CardenzaHAL projects require `203cli` to build. Install via Node.js 18+: `npm install -g 203cli && 203cli skill install` (cloning https://github.com/203-Systems/203-CLI does not install it).
- **Developer guide & rules**: Single-file Markdown reference at https://stage.203.io/develop.md, and web guide at https://stage.203.io/develop.
- **Community API & CLI overview**: https://stage.203.io/llms.txt.
- **Flashing warning**: Never run `idf.py flash` on a Cardenza, as it overwrites the 203 Launcher. Always flash via `203cli flash --bin build/<project>.bin`.
- **Reference firmware**: Cardenza Synth (community code `V6QK28`) at https://github.com/203-Systems/CardenzaSynth.
- **Hardware files**: Schematics and PCB models at https://github.com/203-Systems/Cardenza-Hardware.

## Using Cardenza

- Interactive guide: https://cardenza.203.io/
- Reference manual: https://cardenza.203.io/manual/start/
- Browser simulator: https://cardenza-synth.vercel.app/
